title: Pure Zera
summary: Pure Zera multi-path destiny strategy, following the four divergent evolutionary paths of Warrior of Zera into Level 8 2800 ATK bosses: Ritual (Zera the Mant), Fairy (Archlord Zerato), Fiend (Mazera DeVille), and Synchro (Angel of Zera). The deck fields devastating board wipes, hand rips, and recurring Synchros.

summary.title: Starters
points: Unexpected Dai Special Summons the Level 4 Normal Monster Warrior of Zera directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Rescue Rabbit banishes itself to Special Summon two copies of Warrior of Zera directly from your Deck.
The Sacred Waters in the Sky activates The Sanctuary in the Sky directly from your Deck and adds a Sanctuary-mentioning card to hand.
Pre-Preparation of Rites adds both Zera Ritual and Zera the Mant simultaneously from Deck to hand.
Advanced Ritual Art Ritual Summons Zera the Mant from hand by sending two Level 4 Warrior of Zera from Deck to GY.
Reinforcement of the Army searches Warrior of Zera directly from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Unexpected Dai into Evolution
steps: Activate Unexpected Dai, Special Summoning Warrior of Zera from your Deck.
Activate The Sacred Waters in the Sky to place The Sanctuary in the Sky face-up from your Deck.
Tribute Warrior of Zera while The Sanctuary in the Sky is on the field to Special Summon Archlord Zerato from your hand.
Activate Archlord Zerato's effect, discarding a LIGHT monster (Chaos Mirage Dragon) to destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon two copies of Warrior of Zera from your Deck, overlaying them into a Rank 4 or preparing subsequent tributes.

summary.title: The Four Fates of Zera
points: Archlord Zerato requires The Sanctuary in the Sky and tributing Warrior of Zera; discards 1 LIGHT monster to destroy all monsters the opponent controls.
Mazera DeVille requires Pandemonium and tributing Warrior of Zera; when Special Summoned this way, forces the opponent to discard 3 random cards from their hand.
Zera the Mant is a 2800 ATK Ritual Fiend summoned via Zera Ritual or Advanced Ritual Art, fueling the GY with Warrior of Zera.
Darklord Zerato can be Tribute Summoned with 1 Tribute if you have 4+ DARK monsters with different names in GY, sending 1 DARK monster from hand to destroy all opponent monsters.
Angel of Zera is a Level 8 Synchro (Chaos Mirage Dragon + Warrior of Zera) that gains 100 ATK per opponent's banished card and revives itself during the next Standby Phase after being banished.

summary.title: Bosses & Rank 8 Payoffs
points: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy is overlaid using any two Level 8 Zera bosses (Zerato, Mazera, Mant, or Angel of Zera) to negate Spell activations and redirect attacks.

Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star is overlaid using any two Level 8 Zera bosses to send an opponent's card to the GY without targeting and detach material to protect your cards from destruction.
Chaos Mirage Dragon is a Level 4 LIGHT Tuner that banishes an opponent's monster when used for a Synchro Summon and provides LIGHT discard fodder for Archlord Zerato.
Pandemonium prevents both players from paying LP to activate Archfiend effects and searches an Archfiend when one is destroyed.

main: Warrior of Zera

Core Level 4 EARTH Warrior Normal Monster (1600 ATK / 1600 DEF): the origin of all Zera evolutions! Summoned from the Deck by Unexpected Dai and Rescue Rabbit, sent to the GY by Advanced Ritual Art, and Tributed on the field to Special Summon Archlord Zerato or Mazera DeVille!
Archlord Zerato

Signature Level 8 LIGHT Fairy evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF): Must be Special Summoned from your hand by Tributing 1 face-up 'Warrior of Zera' while 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' is on the field; discards 1 LIGHT monster from your hand to the GY while Sanctuary is on the field to destroy ALL monsters your opponent controls!
Darklord Zerato

Level 8 DARK Fairy fallen evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF): can be Tribute Summoned with 1 Tribute if you have 4+ DARK monsters with different names in your GY; sends 1 DARK monster from your hand to the GY to destroy ALL monsters your opponent controls!
Mazera DeVille

Signature Level 8 DARK Fiend corrupted evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF): Must be Special Summoned from your hand by Tributing 1 face-up 'Warrior of Zera' while 'Pandemonium' is on the field; when Special Summoned this way, your opponent discards 3 random cards from their hand!
Zera the Mant

Signature Level 8 DARK Fiend Ritual evolution (2800 ATK / 2300 DEF; searchable alongside Zera Ritual by Pre-Preparation of Rites!): Ritual Summoned via Zera Ritual or Advanced Ritual Art (sending two Warrior of Zera from your Deck to the GY!).
Chaos Mirage Dragon

Level 4 LIGHT Wyrm Tuner: pairs with Level 4 Warrior of Zera (summoned via Unexpected Dai or Rescue Rabbit) to Synchro Summon Level 8 'Angel of Zera', banishes an opponent's monster when used for a Synchro Summon (boosting Angel of Zera's ATK!), and serves as LIGHT discard fodder for Archlord Zerato!
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to Special Summon 2 copies of 'Warrior of Zera' directly from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons 'Warrior of Zera' directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Zera Ritual
Signature Ritual Spell (searchable by Pre-Preparation of Rites!) that Ritual Summons 'Zera the Mant' from your hand.
Advanced Ritual Art
Ritual Summons Level 8 'Zera the Mant' from your hand by sending two Level 4 'Warrior of Zera' from your Deck to the GY.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Adds both 'Zera Ritual' and 'Zera the Mant' from your Deck or GY to your hand.
The Sacred Waters in the Sky
Activates 'The Sanctuary in the Sky' directly from your Deck so you can immediately Tribute Warrior of Zera to summon Archlord Zerato and wipe your opponent's monsters!
The Sanctuary in the Sky
Field Spell that unlocks Archlord Zerato's Special Summon condition and Raigeki effect.
Pandemonium
Field Spell that unlocks Mazera DeVille's Special Summon condition (and its 3-card hand-rip!).
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Warrior of Zera.
extra: Signature Level 8 LIGHT Fairy Synchro evolution (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners: Level 4 Chaos Mirage Dragon + Level 4 Warrior of Zera; 2800 ATK): gains 100 ATK for each of your opponent's banished cards (boosted immediately by Chaos Mirage Dragon's Synchro banish!); and during the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card was banished, Special Summons this banished card!
